raw.details:
Micromouse Challenge — Navigate the Maze, Beat the Clock

Build an autonomous robot that can map and solve a 10×10 grid maze on its own — no remote control, no manual input. Just your bot, its sensors, and its code against the clock.

Registration fees: Rs. 350
https://formbuilder.ccavenue.com/live/ccavenue/manipal-university-jaipur-2/techideat-2026-202622

Payment Confirmation link:
https://forms.gle/PG5SBptsQ16GA1Fv9

Completion of these forms is mandatory. Failure to submit them will result in the cancellation of your registration.

Format

  • Maze: 6.5 ft × 6.5 ft, 10×10 grid, 198mm cells
  • Path width: 192mm | Wall height: 100mm
  • Each robot gets multiple runs within a fixed time window — a search run to map the maze, followed by speed run(s) on the mapped route
  • Your fastest successful run determines your rank

Eligibility

  • Open to individuals and teams of 2-5
  • Robot must be self-built and self-navigating — fully autonomous once released at the start cell
  • Robot must fit within a 19×19 cm bounding box and stay under 90mm in height

Rules

  • No manual or remote control once a run begins
  • No external positioning aids (e.g., overhead cameras directing the robot)
  • Robot must stay within the maze path at all times — no jumping, flying, or climbing over walls
  • Any wall collision incurs a time penalty; repeated or damaging collisions may disqualify the run
  • Robots are subject to inspection before competing

Process

  1. Register your team and robot details
  2. Report for inspection on competition day
  3. Compete in your allotted run slots (search + speed runs)
  4. Fastest valid completion time wins

Safety

  • All robots must have an accessible power switch
  • LiPo batteries must be declared and transported in fire-resistant cases


    Kindly refer to the attached guidelines to make your micrmouse.
